newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys Nov 15-18 fuel oil below $6.50/T premia.
newsitem.headline: India buys Nov 15-18 fuel oil below $6.50/T premia.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded its tender to buy 14,000 tonnes of November high sulphur fuel oil to Swiss trader, Glencore at below $6.50 per tonne premia over Mideast spot quotes on free on board (fob) basis, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender which closed October 31, sought 3.5 percent sulphur grade, 180 centistoke fuel oil cargo to be delivered to Bombay (Mumbai) or Mangalore on the west coast of India between November 15-18.

A source at Midest bunker firm, FAL Energy said it had lost its offer to Glencore by a slight margin. FAL had submitted the next best offer at between $20-$21 per tonne on a cost and freight (c-and-f) basis.
India had earlier cancelled a tender to buy 25,000 tonnes of fuel oil for delivery between November 16-20.
Its tender to buy 25,000 tonnes for delivery November 26-30 will close on November 7 and offers will be valid until November 8.
India had already purchased a November 6-10 cargo for delivery to Bombay from FAL Energy at $13.50 premia over Mideast quotes on a c-and-f basis.
